saved_alert_Madrid.sql:
SELECT listings.id 
FROM listings 
WHERE (listings.city ILIKE %(city_1)s OR listings.area ILIKE %(area_1)s) AND listings.rental_mode = %(rental_mode_1)s

interactive_madrid_search.sql:
SELECT listings.id 
FROM listings 
WHERE CASE WHEN (trim(listings.postcode) ~ %(trim_1)s) THEN substr(trim(listings.postcode), %(substr_1)s, %(substr_2)s) END = %(param_1)s
